## Scope

Describe the problem, the smallest change, and anything intentionally left out.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass
- [ ] Relevant full regression gates pass
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] Documentation and examples match actual behavior
- [ ] UI changes include accessible synthetic screenshots

## Risk review

- [ ] Security/privacy/tenant implications are described
- [ ] Migrations are additive and historical migrations are untouched, or no migration is needed
- [ ] Public API/SDK compatibility is preserved or explicitly approved
- [ ] No secret, personal data, generated cache, or local environment file is included
